name: smoke
description: Synthetic smoke-test set over three fictional articles generated by generate_pdfs.py. Exercises the whole pipeline (English and Finnish questions, unanswerable questions). Passages are copied verbatim from the generated text. Not a substitute for the manually verified dataset of real articles (SPEC 11.3).

questions.question: Which classifier was more accurate for mineral identification, LDA or KNN, and what accuracies did they reach?
questions.expected_answer: LDA was more accurate: 91.3 percent overall accuracy versus 87.6 percent for KNN.

relevant.passage: LDA achieved an overall accuracy of 91.3 percent and KNN 87.6 percent.

questions.question: How was the number of neighbours k chosen for the KNN classifier?
questions.expected_answer: With 10-fold cross-validation on the training set, which selected k = 5.

relevant.passage: The number of neighbours for KNN was chosen with 10-fold cross-validation on the training set, which selected k = 5.

questions.question: What wavelength range and spectral resolution did the mineral spectra have?
questions.expected_answer: 400 to 2500 nm with a spectral resolution of 10 nm (211 bands).

relevant.passage: Spectra were recorded between 400 and 2500 nm with a spectral resolution of 10 nm, giving 211 bands per spectrum.

questions.question: What happened to KNN accuracy when the principal component step was skipped?
questions.expected_answer: It dropped to 79.8 percent, because KNN is sensitive to noisy bands.

relevant.passage: when the principal component step was skipped, KNN accuracy dropped to 79.8 percent.

questions.question: What was the main source of error in the soil moisture retrieval under forest?
questions.expected_answer: Canopy attenuation: the radar signal from the soil weakens when passing through dense vegetation.

relevant.passage: Canopy attenuation was the main source of error, because the radar signal from the soil weakens as it passes through dense vegetation.

relevant.passage: Images from November to April were excluded because of snow cover.
